query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN observacoes LIKE '[Import]%' THEN '[Import]'
    WHEN observacoes LIKE '[Fluxo]%' THEN '[Fluxo]'
    WHEN observacoes LIKE '[Impostos]%' THEN '[Impostos]'
    WHEN observacoes LIKE '[Salários]%' OR observacoes LIKE '[Salarios]%' THEN '[Salários]'
    ELSE CONCAT('[Manual] ', LEFT(observacoes, 50))
  END as tipo,
  ROUND(SUM(valor), 2) as total,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_custo
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY tipo
ORDER BY total DESC
